mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM common_icon_template_header WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEFAULT_FLAG = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT(CITD.NAME) AS `LABEL`, CITD.NAME AS `VALUE`, CITD.LOGIC_DEL AS `DISABLED` FROM common_icon_template_header CITH LEFT JOIN common_icon_template_detail CITD ON CITH.ID = CITD.HEADER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CITH.USER_ID = #{entity.userId} AND CITD.ICON_TREE_TYPE = 'L'
AND CITD.NAME = #{entity.value}

SELECT DISTINCT(CITD.NAME) AS `LABEL`, SO.URL AS `VALUE`, CITD.LOGIC_DEL AS `DISABLED` FROM common_icon_template_header CITH LEFT JOIN common_icon_template_detail CITD ON CITH.ID = CITD.HEADER_ID LEFT JOIN common_icon ci on CITD.ICON_ID = CI.ID LEFT JOIN sys_oss SO ON SO.ID = CI.FILE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND CITH.USER_ID = #{entity.userId} AND CITD.ICON_TREE_TYPE = 'L'
AND CITD.NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{entity.value}, '%')
